summary_text: In February 2026, the user consistently ordered Amul Masti plain curd products across five independent dates. While the specific pack sizes varied slightly (390 ml on Feb 10 and 200 ml on four other dates), the brand 'Amul' and the product type 'plain curd/dahi' recurred on all five dates, establishing a stable preference. The majority of orders (four out of five) occurred on weekdays in the afternoon, indicating a likely habitual purchasing pattern for this item, although one morning order on Feb 27 breaks the strict afternoon-only consistency.
